title: Möbius/rotation/twist generate full PGL2-normalizer; worst stack is ONE orbit (reduces the sup to ONE representative)
evidence: The 'single worst-case orbit' is an artifact of the F5 #400 trap (domain (1,2,4,3)=<2> IS the FULL group F5*, q-1=n=4). I reproduced the F5 claim exactly (probe_s3_twisted_inversion_merger.py: 100000-stack single orbit, 0 violations), then ran the SAME group (codeword translation + whole-stack scaling + gamma-shift + multiplicative rotation [mcaEvent_rs_rotate] + twisted inversion T (sigma:x->1/x, diagonal d=x^{k-1}) [mcaEvent_monomial]) on RS[F_q, mu_4, k=2] for PROPER subgroups (n=4 < q-1). Probe scripts/probes/_407_conn/probe_C041_orbit_count.py (translation-canonicalized exact search over the q^{n-k} coset reps; maxbad=4 every case). Orbit count of the worst-case extremal set (no-T -> +T): F5 FULL group 2->1 (the claimed collapse); F13 (idx3) 90->45; F17 (idx4) 224->112; F29 (idx7) 1274->637. T stabilizes the code at every proper subgroup (verified; untwisted inversion does NOT) so the mechanism is genuine, but it only ever HALVES the orbit count (it implements gamma<->gamma^{-1}, identical to WBPencilSymmetry.mcaEvent_swap_inv = F2<->F3 self-duality) -- a constant factor 2, never a collapse to 1. The number of worst-case orbits grows ~linearly in q (Theta(q-2)), so at the prize regime (mu_n a thin proper subgroup, n<<q-1) the eps_mca sup is over Theta(q) inequivalent orbit-representatives, not one canonical extremizer.
wall: Paley/BGK. The genuine axiom-clean equivariances (mcaEvent_monomial, mcaEvent_rs_rotate, mcaEvent_swap_inv, epsMCA_eq_iSup_subtype_of_reps) only license a reduction to ORBIT TRANSVERSALS; in the prize regime there are Theta(q) of them and each is a distinct incomplete-character-sum / generalized-Paley configuration. Summing/maxing over them is exactly the BGK sqrt-cancellation for thin mu_n. No reduction in difficulty.
honest_note: Tested n=4 (mu_4) at four primes q=5,13,17,29; the F5 single-orbit fact is reproduced and shown to be the full-group special case. The Lean equivariance lemmas in MCAEquivariance/MCAMonomialEquivariance/WBPencilSymmetry are all genuine and axiom-clean and DO hold at proper subgroups (I checked T stabilizes the proper code) -- only the 'single orbit / canonical extremizer' downstream inference is false in-regime. I did not test n=8/16 directly (q^{2n} too large for exact max-bad even after translation reduction); the n=4 proper-vs-full contrast at four primes with monotone growth (2,90,224,1274 orbits) is the decisive evidence and is exactly the documented #400 trap pattern (full subgroup gives false positives). delta radius fixed at 1/n (the F5 extremal rung); other radii not swept. Probes: scripts/probes/_407_conn/probe_C041_proper_subgroup_orbit.py (mechanism/stabilization), scripts/probes/_407_conn/probe_C041_orbit_count.py (orbit counts). Belongs in DISPROOF_LOG.
